execution_gate.reason: Do not start InterHuman GPU training until the active Inter-X formal evaluation and shape-augmentation stages finish.

data.variants: left/right swap x coordinate anchor x final person order

model.rationale: First pilot keeps released InterMask's 1024-code, 512D, down_t=2, width=512 and depth=2 scale while retaining HHC's separate body/root token structure.
model.quantizer_rationale: Controlled repair of mixed-precision EMA drift and lifetime usage accumulation; FP32 assignment/EMA, clear usage each 21 updates, initialize replacement EMA sum/count together. Same seed, shape, losses, batches and schedule as v2.

optimization.batch_rationale: Do not use gradient accumulation with the EMA-reset quantizers: each microbatch updates codebook EMA state, so accumulation would not reproduce one larger batch. Increase the physical batch only after a measured memory preflight.
optimization.schedule: linear warmup then cosine to zero at the fixed 30000-step full endpoint; the 10000-step pilot is a pause, not a scheduler endpoint

loss.commitment_count: once for the joint two-codebook VQ

automatic_validation.rng_policy: validation is observational and restores Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG and model mode

decision_after_10k.comparison: same frozen official-val requests against the released InterMask VQ and GT self-score
decision_after_10k.shared_val_scorer: tools/score_interhuman_vq_validation.py; 480 val requests, five released batches of 96, seed 20260130
decision_after_10k.selected_hhc_vq_rescore: tools/evaluate_hhc_interhuman_vq_validation.py; independently reload the manifest-selected full-endpoint checkpoint and report the identical metric core
decision_after_10k.final_val_comparison: tools/compare_interhuman_vq_validation.py; fail closed unless HHC and released InterMask scores use the same 480 requests and byte-identical evaluator provenance
decision_after_10k.if_quality_trajectory_is_healthy: Resume the same run to the fixed 30000-step endpoint; compare quality and code utilization against v2, then official InterMask. Step count is not equal data exposure.
decision_after_10k.if_codebook_collapse_or_quality_regressi: diagnose channel utilization and loss balance before changing code count or latent widths; do not launch an unregistered sweep
decision_after_10k.formal_test: only after val selection; use all 20 frozen test replications and identical InterCLIP scorer
